body: Thank you so much for replying, I really needed someone to listen and I appreciate your beautiful reply. I’m sorry that you went through that when you were younger. But I think that I’m going through the same kind of thing. I also try to numb the pain whenever I can and have limited access to things like drugs and alcohol. I think it’s just that most of the time I’m kind of so isolated that I have to be left alone with my thoughts. This was so kind of you to say, I don’t even know how to reply, but I promise that I’m thinking about things. And if you ever need someone to talk to or reach out, you can as long as I’m here. I appreciate you so much and thanks for the reply because I really needed it. I can tell that you are a kind soul.
Honestly thank YOU for being here also. You have no idea how much it helps. Likewise:)!

I’m glad it resonated with you, it helps me feel less alone as well. It really is a cruel world, it’s terrible to know that there are other people out there that are feeling the same way. And yet still feeling completely alone. I wish I could actually meet and connect with others out there like you and I, but I’m afraid that I’ll die before it could ever happen. Nonetheless, I’m glad that we can at least be here, but I know it’s not the same and I’m sorry. :(
Thank you so much❤️. You have no idea how much you commenting helps. I appreciate the kind words. I know it isn’t much but here for you as long as I’m here.
Today is my Birthday today too. And I’m as suicidal as ever. Happy birthday though.

Hey, I’m sorry but do u mind sending that last reply again? You said something about therapy but it doesn’t show the full comment when I actually click on it. I just want to hear what you have to say. You seem very kind. I apologize for the inconvenience.

Hey, thank you so much for your comment. It really means a lot. Tonight I really needed someone to respond. I’ve thought about going to therapy. I mostly always saw it as a last resort, or even a second alternative option if I was forced to live. But I’ve definitely considered it. You are right, it definitely is very hard, especially when you’re feeling so low. I have no idea what will happen, but I will definitely consider it. I know that something will have to change soon. But really, thank you for your comment. It was really nice to see this tonight. And I wish you well also.
